scope: new standalone known-truth benchmark; no EOG-WF endpoint, no public API change

hard unavailable edges remain unavailable under every admitted relaxation; no feasible candidate world returns an explicit STOP, not natural biological impossibility
candidate edge ordering does not alter world fingerprints, compatible-world set or Pareto frontier
independent bounded directed-graph reachability reproduces every EOG finite-world compatibility decision

gates: source set predeclared and included in observed positive set
at least one non-source positive target
all numeric axes finite nonnegative; no scalar weighted composite
hard_unavailable never reopened by barrier permission
same fixed candidate graph and observed set across variants
enumerate all finite edge-derived breakpoints at or above baseline up to 512 worlds; fail closed beyond budget
